title: Multi-Stage Progressive Image Restoration
grouping: No containers. Two horizontal paths: the feature path along the top (input features to output features) and the image path along the bottom (degraded image, restored image, attention maps), joined by vertical arrows. A small legend box in the lower-right corner defines the sigmoid symbol.
shapes_depth: Tensors are drawn as real data: input and output features as offset stacks of viridis-coloured activation images, the degraded and restored images as photo thumbnails, the attention maps as a stack of greyscale images; each carries its shape above in math (H x W x C, H x W x 3). Convolutions are small upright orange boxes labelled 'Conv'; operators are circled +, x and a sigmoid glyph. A pink rounded 'Loss' tag hangs below the restored image on a thick arrow.
proposed_highlight: The whole figure is the module; the supervision point is singled out by the pink 'Loss' tag under the intermediate restored image.
lesson: Draw a module's tensors as stacks of real data - viridis activation maps for features, the actual photo for the intermediate image, greyscale maps for attention - each with its shape above, so every arrow visibly changes the data.
notes: Venue from Semantic Scholar. The figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the whole raster.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: supervised attention module for image restoration

core.what: a feature track on top (F_in to F_out) and an image track below (Degraded I to Restored X_S to attention maps M), joined by vertical links: features drop down to form a residual, and attention maps computed from the restored image rise back to multiply the features

relations.form: the attention-map stack M at the lower right sends an arrow straight up into a multiply circle on the feature track, gating the Conv'd F_in before the residual add and F_out
the image track runs left to right: Degraded I (real rainy photo), an add with the residual R_S, Restored X_S, Conv, a sigmoid circle, the greyscale attention-map stack
the feature track runs along the top from a viridis slice stack F_in through Conv to the multiply and add, with a skip line over the top from F_in to the final add, parallel to the image track below
every tensor is drawn as data with its shape: viridis feature slices labelled H x W x C, real photos labelled H x W x 3, greyscale attention slices labelled H x W x C

channels.colour: viridis = feature tensors; real photo colour = images; greyscale = attention maps; orange = Conv blocks; pink = the Loss tag
channels.shape: slice stacks = multichannel tensors; photos = images; small rectangles = Conv; circles = add / multiply / sigmoid (sigmoid keyed at bottom right)
channels.line: solid black arrows = data flow, one style

quality.strengths: every intermediate is drawn as the actual thing - feature slices, rainy and restored photos, greyscale attention maps - with its shape label, so the reader sees that supervision acts on an image and attention returns to features; the two tracks are straight horizontal lines joined by short vertical links; the one supervised output carries the only pink tag
quality.weaknesses: the skip line from F_in to the final add arches over the top of the whole feature track; the second Conv on the feature track has no label distinguishing it from the R_S Conv; the attention stack is labelled H x W x C but drawn in the image track's greyscale, so its kind (feature-shaped, image-derived) is not obvious

insights.structure: Two horizontal tracks: a feature track on top from F_in (left) to F_out (right) and an image track below from Degraded I through Restored X_S to attention maps M, joined by vertical connections.
insights.data: Features are drawn as stacked viridis-coloured slices labelled H x W x C, images as real rainy viaduct photos labelled H x W x 3, and attention maps as a stack of greyscale slices.
insights.emphasis: The only supervised output, Restored X_S, carries a pink 'Loss' tag beneath it, and the attention maps re-enter the feature track through a multiply circle before the residual add.
insights.flow: F_in branches down via a Conv to a residual R_S added to the degraded image; the restored image goes right through Conv and sigmoid to M, which rises to multiply the conv'd features, then adds back to F_in to give F_out.

arrangement.units: unboxed tensor stacks and small orange Conv tags connected by arrows with circle operators
arrangement.inputs_as: a feature stack F_in (top) and a real degraded photo (bottom)
